description: Use this when you are about to send Bitcoin and need the right fee rate. Bitcoin fee tiers (fastest / 30 min / 60 min / economy / minimum) in sat/vB with the estimated fee in sats, BTC and USD for your transaction size, plus mempool size and backlog, projected next 3 blocks (median fee, fee range), tip height and the next difficulty adjustment. mempool.space with Blockstream Esplora failover, cached 30 s. Returns JSON with: ok, data, sources, fetched_at, cache_age_s. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/btc-fees

vbytes.description: transaction virtual size for the fee estimate (default 141 = 1-in/2-out native SegWit; 60-100000)

name: btc_fees
